verdict.rationale: The only webhook-related evidence (fivetran-docs-47) describes a 'webhooks' connector used to ingest third-party webhook payloads as a data source for usage tracking, not a mechanism for external systems/agents to subscribe to Fivetran platform events (sync completion, connector failures, etc.). No documentation shows Fivetran emitting outbound webhook notifications that an AI-native user could subscribe to; 'Fivetran Alerts' (docs-15) is a dashboard feature with no webhook detail given.
